property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Two copies of every block across three datanodes: survives one node dying, which is the demo.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: 128 MB. Telemetry files are sized well above this so a single file splits across nodes.

property.name: dfs.namenode.heartbeat.recheck-interval
property.description: A datanode is declared dead after 2 x recheck + 10 x heartbeat = 60 s, not the default 10.5 min, so scripts/failover.ps1 can show re-replication live. A production cluster keeps the long default to ride out GC pauses and network blips.
